QF.id: Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_18

question.text: ESG Investing in mutual funds focuses on companies meeting criteria related to:

answer.text: Environmental stewardship, Social responsibility, and corporate Governance standards
Earnings growth, Share price momentum, and GDP correlation
Exchange listing, SEBI compliance, and Global diversification
Equity allocation, Sector rotation, and Growth-value balance

explanation.text: The Logic: ESG stands for Environmental, Social, and Governance. SEBI has introduced an ESG sub-category under thematic equity schemes, with listed ESG strategies that fund managers can follow when launching ESG schemes. The Trap: The distractors cleverly create alternative "ESG" acronyms that sound plausible. Candidates who don't know the actual expansion may pick an option that sounds financially relevant. Note: ESG schemes sit within the thematic equity category and must follow the SEBI-listed ESG strategies that define the sub-category.
